title: AFP prioritizes missiles, other weapons for territorial defense

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) is prioritizing the acquisition of missiles and other weapons systems to strengthen territorial defense and deter potential threats amid the presence of Chinese naval vessels along international sea routes near the country. AFP chief General Antonio Nafarrete said Friday that the military was focusing its procurement priorities on “kinetic” capabilities, referring to weapons systems designed to physically strike, damage or destroy targets, including missiles, artillery and bombs. “We are now concentrating on our kinetic requirements, basically for territorial defense,” Nafarrete told reporters in a chance interview on the sidelines of the […]...
